tests.decision: An A/B test fits: at 4.14% and about 2,450 sessions a week, each variant reaches 100 sign-ups in 2 weeks. Run whole weeks and never call it early.
hypotheses: If the H1 echoes the ads ('online booking', the setup time), then sign_up per session rises from 4.14%, because 58% of sessions come from ads whose promise the hero doesn't repeat.
If the rating and a named quote sit under Start free, then Start free clicks per session rise, because all proof sits after the middle of the page today.
If Start free shows in the first mobile screen, then mobile sign_up per session rises, because 63% of sessions are on mobile and the button sits just below the first screen.
